metadata.case_title: Independent Sugar Corporation Limited vs Girish Sriram Juneja
metadata.summary: These statutory appeals under Section 62 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 involve the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process of Hindustan National Glass and Industries Ltd. and the approval of the combination between HNGIL and AGI Greenpac. The key issue revolves around the potential adverse impact on competition due to the merger. The Appellant, Independent Sugar Corporation Ltd., challenges the approval granted to AGI Greenpac's Resolution Plan, citing non-compliance with mandatory CCI approval requirements. The case delves into the intricate timelines, procedural lapses, and discrepancies in data surrounding the approval process. The arguments focus on the statutory compliance under the IBC, the Competition Act, and the authority of the RP and CoC in approving Resolution Plans.
